2607.12686.title: Segregate, Refine, Integrate: Decomposing Multimodal Fusion for Sentiment Analysis
2607.12686.paper_summary: Multimodal fusion must simultaneously refine modality-specific signals and model cross-modal interactions; two competing objectives typically entangled within the same operation. We propose \textbf{SeRIn} (\textbf{Se}gregate, \textbf{R}efine, \textbf{In}tegrate), a multimodal LM fusion scheme that enforces this separation as an architectural prior. Modality-specific representations evolve along isolated pathways, each refined against its respective encoder context, while a dedicated cross-modal pathway accumulates their joint evolution without contaminating unimodal streams. Full cross-modal interaction is deferred to a final prediction step - ablations confirm that structured interactions, not added capacity, drive the gains; gate analysis under visual corruption reveals emergent modality reweighting without explicit supervision. SeRIn achieves state-of-the-art results on CH-SIMS and CMU-MOSEI, improving all metrics on both benchmarks.
2607.12686.paper_summary_zh: 多模態融合必須同時精煉特定模態的信號並建模跨模態的互動；這兩個相互競爭的目標通常在同一操作中交織。我們提出了\textbf{SeRIn}（\textbf{Se}gregate, \textbf{R}efine, \textbf{In}tegrate），這是一種多模態LM融合方案，強調將這種分離作為架構先驗。特定模態的表示沿著孤立的路徑演變，每個路徑都根據其各自的編碼器上下文進行精煉，而專門的跨模態路徑則在不污染單模態流的情況下累積它們的聯合演變。完整的跨模態互動被推遲到最後的預測步驟——消融實驗確認結構化的互動，而非增加的容量，驅動了增益；在視覺損壞下的閘分析揭示了新興的模態重加權，而無需明確的監督。SeRIn在CH-SIMS和CMU-MOSEI上達到了最先進的結果，改善了這兩個基準的所有指標。
